prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original hand-painted medieval RTS animation sprite sheet. Image 1 is the identity and art-style reference, not an output layout. Create exactly SIXTEEN separate full-body poses of the Infantry swordsman, laid out in a strict four-column, four-row grid. Read left to right then next row. Same helmet, chainmail, leather armour, blue tunic and round blue shield with gold heraldry. First eight frames: a complete looping walking cycle, legs alternating and sword/shield moving naturally. Last eight frames: a complete sword attack, guard, wind-up, slash, follow-through, recovery to guard. All frames use exactly the same isometric camera and facing as the reference, the same character proportions, equipment, textures, palette and upper-left lighting. Make actual articulated limb poses, not duplicate cutouts shifted or rotated. Each cell has one entire character, fixed character scale, same ground-contact baseline and centre, generous transparent margins; limbs, equipment and shadows never touch adjacent cells or the sheet edge. Use a landscape 1536 by 1024 composition with 4 equal columns and 4 equal rows. Soft tiny contact shadow only. Preserve the detailed painted realistic medieval look, original identity, and blue recolourable cloth. Transparent background, real alpha. No ground, scene, backdrop, grids, cell borders, labels, numbers, text, icons, pixel art or motion trails.

knightBackgroundCleanup: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: this exact sixteen-frame mounted-knight sprite sheet. Remove ONLY the grey/white gradient haze/background between and around the sixteen characters. Produce a genuinely fully transparent alpha background, alpha zero in all empty space, including corners and between all cells. Preserve every horse, rider, lance, plume, limb pose, exact cell position, character scale, colours, shading, textures and the exact four-column four-row layout. Do not move, redraw, rescale, add or remove any knight or equipment. Keep tiny local contact shadows if needed, but remove the broad background gradient entirely. No labels, grid, text or other changes.
